description: Run an XPath 1.0 expression on XML: node-sets (elements, attributes, text…), numbers (count(), sum()), strings and booleans. Full XPath 1.0: all axes, predicates, operators and the core function library. Namespace prefixes declared anywhere in the document can be used as-is; a default namespace on the root gets the prefix "d" (e.g. //d:book), as on the website. Each matched node comes back as XML text plus its type, name and XPath location. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/xml-format/

limit.description: Return at most this many nodes (default 1000).

namespaces.description: Extra or overriding prefix → namespace URI bindings, e.g. {"atom":"http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"}.

path.description: Or: a path to a XML file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

name: xml_query
title: XML XPath query
